_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Hull Mounted Sonar Self-Noise Report
summary: The Hull Mounted Sonar Self-Noise Control Report provides consolidated design information used by the Government to verify Contractor efforts are consistent with the specified Sonar Self-Noise Control Report.
description_purpose: The Hull Mounted Sonar Self-Noise Control Report provides consolidated design information used by the Government to verify that Contractor efforts are consistent with the specified Sonar Self-Noise Control Report.
application_interrelationship: This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Hull Mounted Sonar Self-Noise Control Report shall be in the Contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Hull Mounted Sonar Self-Noise Control Report shall identify and characterize machinery and equipment (such as size, location relative to sonar transducers, horsepower, RPM, and capacity) representing potential sources of sonar self-noise (noise-critical machinery). Noise critical machinery shall include propulsion diesel generators, ship service diesel generators, air conditioning machinery, refrigeration plants, air compressors, purifiers, sea connected pumps, non-seaconnected pumps greater than 1/2 hp, sewage treatment machinery complex, engine room exhaust fans, plus other auxiliary machinery units located within 40 feet of sonar transducers and driven by motors of power rating greater than 1/2 hp.

children.title: The mounting system shall be characterized for each resiliently mounted noise source.
children.content: The mount manufacturer, size, model, and loading, and all flexible connections to the mounted unit shall be identified.

children.title: Calculations shall be identified which demonstrate that
children.content: machinery noise isolation and machinery-to-sonar separation distances are such that the total noise level at the sonar requirement in the specifications are met.

children.title: Line diagrams and sketches of each system containing noise critical machinery shall be included showing all noise control features to be installed.
children.content: The diagrams shall contain sufficient installation information on noise control features for training, production accomplishment, and inspection verification.

children.title: Results of resonance avoidance analyses for each foundation, as required by the specifications, shall be included.
children.content: Assumptions and analysis procedures shall be clearly defined and a sample calculation included. Forcing frequencies and calculated foundation resonances shall be identified.

children.title: For piping penetrations within 20 feet of
children.content: sonar transducers or piping penetrations of structural bulkheads below the waterline and adjacent to the sonar receivers, the separation distances from the sonar transducers and distance to the hull shall be identified and the location, type, and extent of any damping treatments shall be described.
